title: Mexican Apricot Toast
description: A sweet and crunchy twist on traditional Mexican toast, topped with caramelized apricots and crunchy ingredients.
instructions: Slice the Australian bread into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a pan, heat 1 tablespoon of honey over medium heat.
Add the sliced apricots to the pan and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until caramelized.
Sprinkle the toasted bread with cinnamon and salt.
Top the toasted bread with caramelized apricots, crunchy almonds, and crunchy tortilla chips.
Drizzle the remaining 1 tablespoon of honey over the top of the toast.
